title: Footnotes to a war
creator_credit: United Nations Films and Simone Di Bagno
brief_description: By focusing on three refugees from Southeast Asia - a former soldier turned medic, a child, and a young woman - this film highlights some of the problems of resettlement and ensuing loss of cultural identity. Narrated by Lu Yu. Suitable for upper secondary level.
